# Private feature3 classification consumer

This makes the released one-insert SPLICE mapping usable as **GSEM block
classification**, not as a production renderer/navigation/INLINE cache. All
positive records originate from the actual C7/C34 baseline writer and real
public letter insertion, R14 and SuperMark C40 dirty-line convergence. No host
semantic records, CP, root flags, source identity or event are positive seeds.
The test's host seam only follows the 6502 REQUEST/OP continuation between
foreground calls. No same-slot call nesting is introduced.

Input is immutable `build/cache-editor-product/20261026T045019460982Z/fixture`:
resident `62954d299f47186de29514266b0ecf62054c0023452916fa52cd8c83ad8a4a52`,
binding `6165105579296b1c86c04e3665182374`, D81
`48c2b89b1dcbe52aaa5fdb4ef7f960d44e896cb5993971cc94dee8f0faf1f818`.
The original54 packaged assets, including C35, are used unchanged. Source/code
in the earlier `splice-probe` release is copied and rebound, never edited.

## Executable routing and size

| Asset | Slot/id | Payload | Free |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: |
| immutable released producer `splice` | C40 |3909 |187 |
| immutable released transport `spliceio` | R34 |4082 |14 |
| new selector `splicequery` | C41 |1211 |2885 |

No resident BSS, ZP, new object or REU bank. The existing owner4 BC frame576,
reader86 at `$8DAD`, and the released splice loan `$8880..$8B23` are reused.
The diagnostic prefix `$8800..$887F`, VIEW, source window/gap, ReadyOS shim,
parent `$9134..$9177` (except REQUEST/OP), and source packets remain outside
this worker's writes. GSEM input0..4 remains unchanged.

C41 op0 BEGIN, op1 STEP, op2 CANCEL: owner4 is required before phase access;
Plain returns A2/Cclear before phase/output writes. The observer must be ARMED
without LOST/MUTATING/ACTIVE, empty valid ring topology and no existing source
lease. Wrong owner returns B2/Cset opaquely. A1/Cclear requests another bounded
foreground slice, A0/Cclear means final classification, A2 is optional miss;
errors set carry. This is the existing query-call convention.

BEGIN starts an actual R14 lease and R34 checked readonly root OPEN. Each STEP
checks captured token/ticket/incarnation, ring topology, flags and actual R14
GUARD. A baseline flags1 root ends this selector's lease and requests original
C35 op0, A1; C35 retains all its original validation and output behavior. A
flags3 root requests R34 mapped query6/7. R14 and R34 always finish sequentially,
never R-to-R nesting. Other feature combinations are rejected; bit4 belongs to
the separate lexical-link proposal (flags5 BASE|LEX, flags7 BASE|MAP|LEX), and
is **not** supported here.

The mapped path executes the released complete typed-root/page/directory,
manifest, dirty record, old root, old CR page, per-record CRC, canonical
progression and base/live mapping checks. It then checks the durable event32
against the manifest and current actual59-byte source identity, revision pair,
generation, pending flag, length and ticket before resident END. Only then are
GSEM KIND/LANG/LEVEL/MARKER/START/END/BODY/ROLE/REVERSE/HEIGHT/INLINE published.
Unchanged CRs keep their original baseline ticket; only the actual reparsed
record has the live ticket. Derived mapped coordinates/CRC do not reticket
stored CRs. No INLINE or lexical event stream is consumed/certified here.
INLINE is the original conservative hint: zero only for completed empty count
and NULL ref; terminal EOF remains conservative1.

CANCEL/error releases only this saved source lease, clears ACTIVE/page proof,
invalidates the private state, and never writes REU or retires an event. Missing
R14/R34 uses resident END. Missing C41 is tested through actual root
`se_editor_service` failure and its existing BC_ACTIVE + saved86 cleanup. A
foreign actual R14 lease is refused without ending it. A second actual public
edit leaves an unread SPLICE and is refused; feature3 composition is absent.

## Qualification and reproduction

```
python3 tests/test_cache_splice_query.py
python3 tests/test_cache_splice_query.py --mixed
python3 tests/test_cache_splice_query.py --region --smoke
python3 tests/test_cache_splice_query.py --inline --smoke
```

The ordinary gate compares all57 live canonical boundaries plus three baseline
C35 cases. Mixed source compares all123 live boundaries plus three baseline
cases and includes heading/list/BASIC-open/code/close/region/end. The region
smoke preserves real nonzero incoming/outgoing parser carry. The inline case
proves unchanged baseline C35 hints, then requires the released producer's
multi-CR-page refusal (C1), preserving root, unread queue, source and history.
It does not claim mapped INLINE stream reuse.

Every successful query step checks the entire16MiB unchanged, all source/hot
window/history/selection state unchanged, parent source packets/controller,
GSEM inputs, display/style RAM and shim unchanged. The producer has only its
released alternate-root/directory/journal/shadow-page writable spans; the old
root/CR page remain exact. Faults cover each selector/mapped yield, missing
R14/R34/C41, changed source revision/ticket/caps/ring head, six foreign owners,
Plain, unsupported valid-CRC root features0/2/5/7/255, corrupt page CRC, real
foreign source lease, actual type53 release, and second public edit refusal.
Fault corruption uses the real checked logical object API, not positive seeds.
Artifacts include exact per-run verifier, frozen fixture/source, build maps,
sealed images, source bytes, call/operation/instruction traces and results.

Costs are CPU instruction counts, not PAL cycles or measured UI latency.
Ordinary mapped queries take20..23 calls and121474..139926 instructions in the
initial measured run; these include source/root/CRC/overlay admission costs.
The selector adds a root selection pass to baseline queries. No speedup claim.

## Required production work — not implemented

* Root routing must admit the odd C41 completion as query completion. For the
  frozen dispatcher, `CMP #40` upper cache-worker limit can become `CMP #42`
  with no byte growth; even C40 completion would restart C21, odd41 resumes its
  actual query caller. The component test follows REQUEST/OP itself; it does
  not claim this production change is present.
* Classification callers must route BEGIN to the selector. Original C35 stays
  strict and refuses feature3/C2, which is explicitly tested. C37/C39 or other
  feature1 readers must not receive feature3 directly. Complete feature-aware
  INLINE/layout/navigation routing, or an authenticated actual-parser fallback,
  is required before formatted editor reuse can be claimed.
* GSEM classification does not build/rebase layout, source projection, caret or
  styles. Unchanged classification is not a layout-validity certificate.
* RootCOW journal publication is only the released narrow single-insert scheme.
  Subsequent SPLICE/REKEY, deletes/replaces, markup/fence/CR edits, arbitrary
  multipage CR layouts, EOF/large-body/high24 edits remain unsupported.
* This prototype imports three private assets in addition to54. On this exact
  frozen cold layout COLD ends exclusive `$0EF5` (11 bytes to `$0F00`); three
  low/high/length entries cost9 bytes. Names can alias existing unique DOS
  substrings EDIT (`file0+1`,4), TAIL (`file37+4`,4), PAINT (`file27+4`,5), so
  arithmetic leaves2 cold bytes without new strings. Catalog64 covers57.
  This is a measured input budget, **not** a linked production startup proof;
  later catalog packing changes need a fresh link. Asset registration, disk
  names, C21/C23 routing, stack graph, missing-worker/root failure gates and
  current-binding qualification remain parent integration work.
